question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query: SELECT CASE WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item lines' WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line' ELSE 'Multiple item lines' END AS LINE_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, COUNT(*) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS SHARE_OF_ALL_ORDERS, AVG(ITEM_QUANTITY) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_ORDER FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN LINE_GROUP = 'No item lines' THEN 1 WHEN LINE_GROUP = 'One item line' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

SELECT CASE WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL OR ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item lines' WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line' ELSE 'Multiple item lines' END AS LINE_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, COUNT(*) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS SHARE_OF_ALL_ORDERS, AVG(ITEM_QUANTITY) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_ORDER FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN LINE_GROUP = 'No item lines' THEN 1 WHEN LINE_GROUP = 'One item line' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

action.answer: For 2025 recorded order dates, 3,052,089 of 4,359,773 orders had multiple item lines: 70.005700% of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 3.484769 for multi-line orders and 1.219753 for one-line orders (1,307,684 orders). No orders with zero item lines were recorded (0 orders; 0.000000% of all orders).
